[Unticketed] Don't log an error if someone calls callback directly (#8645)

## Summary

## Changes proposed
* Don't raise a 500 / error when someone calls our login callback
without required parameters

## Context for reviewers
We received an error earlier today for someone calling our callback
endpoint for the login flow without any parameters. This shouldn't
happen for any normal operation, and any normal operation should handle
this with a proper redirect. This makes it so the error won't get logged
as an error by adjusting the validation to be more explicit.

Note that unlike our normal endpoints, we can't do this as part of
request validation because that wouldn't allow us to redirect the
response.

## Validation steps
You can see this issue right now by going to
`http://localhost:8080/v1/users/login/callback` - without this change
it'll cause the API to fail and log an error, you won't be redirected.
With the fix, you'll redirect through to the frontend and end up at
`http://localhost:3000/unauthenticated`.

## Summary

## Changes proposed

<!-- What was added, updated, or removed in this PR. -->
Added `att` to the namespace declarations in GG_LobbyingForm's XML

legacy declaration order (att, glob, globLib)

tests.

## Context for reviewers

<!-- Technical or background context, more in-depth details of the
implementation, and anything else you'd like reviewers to know about
that will help them understand the changes in the PR. -->
The legacy Grants.gov lobbying form XML declares four namespaces on the
root LobbyingForm element: att, glob, globLib, and GG_LobbyingForm. Our
implementation was missing att. While the other three namespaces were
declared on the outer grant:GrantApplication wrapper (making them
technically in-scope via XML namespace inheritance), the att namespace
was absent entirely.

Note there is an open ticket for fixing other CLI tests, mostly due to
namespace updates we have made.

(screenshots, GIF demos, code examples or output). -->

```xml
<GG_LobbyingForm:LobbyingForm
	xmlns:att="http://apply.grants.gov/system/Attachments-V1.0"
	xmlns:glob="http://apply.grants.gov/system/Global-V1.0"
	xmlns:globLib="http://apply.grants.gov/system/GlobalLibrary-V2.0"
	xmlns:GG_LobbyingForm="http://apply.grants.gov/forms/GG_LobbyingForm-V1.1" GG_LobbyingForm:FormVersion="1.1">
	<GG_LobbyingForm:ApplicantName>legal</GG_LobbyingForm:ApplicantName>
	<GG_LobbyingForm:AuthorizedRepresentativeName>
		<globLib:FirstName
			xmlns:globLib="http://apply.grants.gov/system/GlobalLibrary-V2.0">M
		</globLib:FirstName>
		<globLib:LastName
			xmlns:globLib="http://apply.grants.gov/system/GlobalLibrary-V2.0">H
		</globLib:LastName>
	</GG_LobbyingForm:AuthorizedRepresentativeName>
	<GG_LobbyingForm:AuthorizedRepresentativeTitle>123</GG_LobbyingForm:AuthorizedRepresentativeTitle>
	<GG_LobbyingForm:AuthorizedRepresentativeSignature>Mike  Huneke</GG_LobbyingForm:AuthorizedRepresentativeSignature>
	<GG_LobbyingForm:SubmittedDate>2026-02-24</GG_LobbyingForm:SubmittedDate>
</GG_LobbyingForm:LobbyingForm>
```

```xml
<GG_LobbyingForm:LobbyingForm
    xmlns:GG_LobbyingForm="http://apply.grants.gov/forms/GG_LobbyingForm-V1.1" GG_LobbyingForm:FormVersion="1.1">
    <GG_LobbyingForm:SubmittedDate>2026-02-24</GG_LobbyingForm:SubmittedDate>
    <GG_LobbyingForm:ApplicantName>test</GG_LobbyingForm:ApplicantName>
    <GG_LobbyingForm:AuthorizedRepresentativeName>
      <globLib:LastName>h</globLib:LastName>

    </GG_LobbyingForm:AuthorizedRepresentativeName>
    <GG_LobbyingForm:AuthorizedRepresentativeTitle>title</GG_LobbyingForm:AuthorizedRepresentativeTitle>
    <GG_LobbyingForm:AuthorizedRepresentativeSignature>mike.huneke+test@focusconsulting.io</GG_LobbyingForm:AuthorizedRepresentativeSignature>
  </GG_LobbyingForm:LobbyingForm>
```

<?xml version='1.0' encoding='utf-8'?>
<GG_LobbyingForm:LobbyingForm xmlns:GG_LobbyingForm="http://apply.grants.gov/forms/GG_LobbyingForm-V1.1" xmlns:att="http://apply.grants.gov/system/Attachments-V1.0" xmlns:glob="http://apply.grants.gov/system/Global-V1.0" xmlns:globLib="http://apply.grants.gov/system/GlobalLibrary-V2.0" GG_LobbyingForm:FormVersion="1.1">
  <GG_LobbyingForm:ApplicantName>legal</GG_LobbyingForm:ApplicantName>
  <GG_LobbyingForm:AuthorizedRepresentativeName>
    <globLib:FirstName>M</globLib:FirstName>
    <globLib:LastName>H</globLib:LastName>
  </GG_LobbyingForm:AuthorizedRepresentativeName>
  <GG_LobbyingForm:AuthorizedRepresentativeTitle>123</GG_LobbyingForm:AuthorizedRepresentativeTitle>
  <GG_LobbyingForm:AuthorizedRepresentativeSignature>Mike Huneke</GG_LobbyingForm:AuthorizedRepresentativeSignature>
